$comment: The Via Lucis (Way of Light / Stations of the Resurrection, Salesian origin 1988; included in the Vatican's Jubilee 2000 'Pilgrim Prayers') as shipped in the viaLucis bundle — a flat steps-type devotion: Sign of the Cross, fourteen scriptural stations from Easter to Pentecost, the composed Regina Caeli (antiphon + paschal versicle/response + collect, from the shared hardcoded texts), and a closing Sign of the Cross (17 steps). Station bodies are the paschal acclamation ('Adoramus te, Christe... quia per sanctam crucem et resurrectionem tuam redemisti mundum') + the cited passage + citation, per language: la Clementine Vulgate and en Douay-Rheims (both drbo.org). Station list and citations follow the widely used fourteen-station form (catholic-resources.org, Felix Just SJ). Languages: la, en — further languages welcome as verified translations arrive (the Hebrew Via Lucis awaits a source, like the stations' did).
